svg.title: Itojinsei — The Iron Loom. Draft 2 / Magnet classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Taut Filament forks into Razor Strands then Severing Lattice, or Threadbound Vigor then Weaver Ascendant. Tangling Snare forks into Constricting Coils then Iron Cocoon, or Conductive Seam then Galvanic Marionette. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Magnet-classified Itojinsei jutsu.

The Control trait reaches potency through two universal Decrease Damage Given rows (Wire Blast Plus 30%, an ally-hazard circle; Eternal Embrace 35%) and one 35% Increase Damage Taken row on Lightning Threads (Lightning/Magnet/None/Wind). The kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Reflect, Lifesteal or Heal row, so the tree offers no defensive route: root Taut Filament carries the burst and amplifier routes, root Tangling Snare the suppression and exposure routes; row-weighted full builds over all 14 legal allocations run 19\u201332 against the Taiyo Kami reference's 16\u201331 on nine rows (Advanced-bearing builds 22\u201332 against 20\u201331)."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Taut Filament","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"Draw the wire tight and every tremor on the line is yours to read.","coverage_note":"Self damage buffs 35\u219237% (Spiraling Wires; Eternal Embrace); Lightning Threads exposure 35\u219237%. Marionette"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: root Taut Filament (+2 self Increase Damage Given on two rows, +2 exposure on one) forks into a Damage route (Razor Strands \u2192 Severing Lattice) and an amplifier route (Threadbound Vigor \u2192 Weaver Ascendant). Root Tangling Snare (+3 Decrease Damage Given on two rows, the one broadly useful control tag outside the offense root) forks into a suppression route (Constricting Coils \u2192 Iron Cocoon) and an exposure route (Conductive Seam \u2192 Galvanic Marionette). 2/4/4 nodes; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP.","Flats scaled by coverage. Damage reaches four Magnet rows (45/40/40/40) and keeps the reference ladder +2/+3 (max +5: Iron Web 50, the rest 45), row-weighted 20 against Taiyo Kami's 15. Increase Damage Given reaches two stacking self rows that leak beyond the kit: +2/+2/+3 (max +7, 42%), the two-row ceiling. Decrease Damage Given reaches two universal rows, one an ally hazard: +3/+2/+4 (max +9; 39%/44%), under the single-row +10. Increase Damage Taken is one row: +2 root, +3/+5 route, max +10 (45%) only with both roots.","Capstone secondaries: Weaver Ascendant and Iron Cocoon add +2 exposure under Conductive Seam's +3; Galvanic Marionette's +2 suppression equals Constricting Coils' +2, so the capstone-less hybrid (both roots, Coils, Seam: DDG +5, IDT +5) is dominated by Galvanic Marionette in Coils' place (IDT +10). Row-weighted nodes: Foundations 6/6, Hidden Arts 8/4/4/3, Advanced Arts 12/8/10/9; full builds over all 14 allocations 19\u201332 against Taiyo Kami's 16\u201331 (Advanced-bearing 22\u201332 against 20\u201331).","Passives and pierce: Spiraling Wires' self Increase Damage Given row is Bukijutsu/Speed/Strength-filtered with no element, so at the pin (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73) it multiplies every Bukijutsu, Speed/Strength or element-less hit, weapons and basic attacks included; Eternal Embrace's row (Lightning/Magnet/None/Wind) multiplies Lightning, Magnet, Wind or element-less hits. Both stack on the 25% + 0.15/level IDG passive, which also multiplies the enhanced Magnet Damage rows. The DDG rows (four stat types, no element) reach every non-pierce hit; no modifier here touches pierce.","Delivery and uptime: every cast is cooldown 7 and every percentage row lasts 2 rounds. Iron Web Entrapment (A, line, range 4), Wire Blast Plus (D, circle spawn, range 4), Spiraling Wires (C, single, range 5) and Lightning Threads (A, single, range 4) all cost 60 AP, so one Damage cast lands per round. Eternal Embrace is the only cheap cast: a 40 AP B-rank circle spawn on an enemy (range 5) with two supported rows; its self buff row needs a legal enemy target. Lightning Threads is the single exposure carrier: one row, 2 rounds per 7.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Tangling Snare (suppression 33%/38%) or Threadbound Vigor (buffs 39%); Amplifier takes Tangling Snare or Razor Strands (47/42/42/42); Suppression takes Taut Filament (buffs 37%, exposure 39%) or Conductive Seam (exposure 40%); Exposure takes Taut Filament (exposure 45%) or Constricting Coils (suppression 37%/42%, exposure 43%). 13 of 14 full allocations are non-dominated (the Coils + Seam hybrid above) and every node appears in one. Four examples, one per capstone."],"risks":["Self-buff leakage: neither Increase Damage Given row has a binding filter at the pin (Spiraling Wires: Bukijutsu/Speed/Strength, no element; Eternal Embrace: Lightning/Magnet/None/Wind), so the +7 maximum raises matching normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in each two-round window, and both rows stack on the caster (84%) over the 25% + 0.15/level passive. Uptime not simulated.","Ally hazard: Wire Blast Plus row 1 (Decrease Damage Given) is an OTHER_USER AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire none (=ALL), so allies in the radius-1 circle also receive the debuff; the caster is never a target of an OTHER_USER area jutsu (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a74b). The suppression route takes it from 30% to 39%; Eternal Embrace's row is friendly fire ENEMIES. Positioning decides.","Exposure concentration: Increase Damage Taken has one row (Lightning Threads, 60 AP, single target, 2 rounds); the full route reaches 45% (+10, the percentage guardrail; reference IDT maximum +7), amplifying player, weapon and ally Lightning, Magnet, Wind or element-less non-pierce hits per 7-round cast. User-owned fallback: Conductive Seam +3 / Galvanic Marionette +4 (+9 with Taut Filament).","Damage concentration: +5 power lands on four Magnet rows, so the burst route is row-weighted 20 against the reference's 15 on three rows (+33%) and the strongest full build reads 32 against Taiyo Kami's 31; floors sit 1\u20133 above the reference (19 vs 16; Advanced-bearing 22 vs 20). User-owned fallback: Razor Strands +2 / Severing Lattice +2 (+4; Iron Web 49, others 44). Not simulated.","Eternal Embrace delivery: the self Increase Damage Given row is realized on the caster at cast time (actions.ts 980\u20131004 / 1060\u20131075) whenever the OTHER_USER AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN has a legal enemy target; it is not positional and no ground effect is created. The Decrease Damage Given row hits each living non-caster user in the radius-1 circle once (friendly fire ENEMIES). Buffprevent is unsupported.","Classification: Magnet is the single signature element on all four Damage rows, but Houkyuken [INCLUDE] carries Magnet on 6 rows (4 damage), so the label works only as a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification, not a bare element match. Under the current resolver 6 of 9 supported rows match Magnet directly; the three element-less rows fall back to None. Normal-jutsu collision unverified.","No defensive route: the kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Reflect, Lifesteal or Heal row, and the 15% Lightning Decrease Damage Taken passive is not a jutsu row, so every build is offense or control; stun (Iron Web Entrapment), redirection (Spiraling Wires), decrease-heal (Lightning Threads) and buffprevent (Eternal Embrace) receive nothing.","Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and ranked sparring; normal-tree potency policy is unapproved (combined stacking audit required). g.text: Draft 2 / Magnet classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Itojinsei jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
